item.content:encoded:
Ministry of Home Affairs
Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah inaugurates and lays foundation stones for various projects of Chandigarh Administration worth ₹258 crore
Development projects worth ₹258 crore, covering education, healthcare, justice, administration, research and innovation, are being inaugurated and their foundation stones laid
By 2029, Chandigarh Police will rank first in the country in terms of residential satisfaction among police personnel
Opposition has been losing elections for past 15 years and has now found a new way to make its presence felt by holding a mock Parliament
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi is steering the country towards rapid progress and development
Article 370 has been abrogated, Naxalism has been eliminated, and Triple Talaq has been abolished, now, by Dec 31, 2029, we are determined to make the entire country, including Punjab, drug-free
Opposition leaders are disrupting the functioning of Parliament to prevent mothers and sisters from getting 33% reservation, PM Shri Narendra Modi is determined to ensure 33% reservation for women of India, this is our firm resolve
People of the country are watching closely who is making the nation secure and developed, promoting innovation, introducing the New Education Policy, and making the country economically prosperous
Posted On: 01 NOV 2026 7:41PM by PIB Delhi

Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah today inaugurated various projects and laid the foundation stones for several others, worth ₹258 crore, of the Chandigarh Administration. On this occasion, Punjab Governor and Administrator of Chandigarh Shri Gulab Chand Kataria, along with several other dignitaries were present.

Addressing the gathering on the occasion, Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah said that Chandigarh was established on this day in 1966, Haryana was formed, and the Chandigarh Police came into existence. On this very day, the Chandigarh Police was also awarded the President’s Colour. He said that over the 60-year journey from 1966 to 2026, Chandigarh has earned recognition across the country for its urban planning and development. In a way, Chandigarh has become an integral part of the identity of the entire North India. Today, development projects worth ₹258 crore are being inaugurated and their foundation stones laid here.

Shri Amit Shah said that development works worth ₹258 crore, covering education, healthcare, justice, administration, research and innovation, are being inaugurated and their foundation stones laid today. He said that the City-UT Bus Depot, built at a cost of ₹68 crore, is being inaugurated. Type-3 residential quarters, constructed at a cost of ₹68 crore, have also been built to provide accommodation to police personnel. He expressed confidence that, before 2029, Chandigarh Police would rank first in the country in terms of residential satisfaction among police personnel.

Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah said that the Opposition has been losing elections for the past 15 years and has now found a new way in the form of a mock Parliament. He said that if their approach continues to be characterised by spreading falsehoods, creating disorder and negativity, disrupting the functioning of Parliament, and taking parliamentary issues to the streets to create a ruckus, they will once again have to sit in the Opposition for the next five years.

Shri Amit Shah said that, on the one hand, Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi is steering the country towards rapid progress and development. Article 370 has been abrogated, Naxalism has been eliminated, and Triple Talaq has been abolished. He said that by December 31, 2029, the entire country, including Punjab, will be made drug-free.

Shri Amit Shah said that, on the one hand, Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi is steering the country towards rapid progress and development. Article 370 has been abrogated, Naxalism has been eliminated, and Triple Talaq has been abolished. He said that by December 31, 2029, the entire country, including Punjab, will be made drug-free. He said that Prime Minister Modi is also driving the creation of world-class infrastructure across the country. The largest cricket stadium, the highest over-bridge and the longest bridge are being built in India today. Infrastructure projects worth ₹11 lakh crore are underway. He said that electricity and toilets have reached every poor household, every poor family has been brought into the banking system through bank accounts, and every poor person is receiving five kilograms of free food grains per month. Schools are being opened for children, while opposition leaders are disrupting the functioning of Parliament to prevent women from getting 33 per cent reservation. He asserted that providing 33 per cent reservation to the women of India is the firm resolve of Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi and the government. The people of the country are closely observing all these developments and are well aware of who is making the country secure and developed, who is promoting innovation, who has introduced the New Education Policy, and who is making the country economically prosperous.

 

*****

RK/RR/PS/PR

item.title: Union Minister for Railways Flags Off Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper Express Train
item.dc:creator: Ministry of Railways
item.description: Ministry of Railways Union Minister for Railways Flags Off Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper Express Train Union Ministers Pralhad Joshi, H. D. Kumaraswamy, Minister of State for Railways V. Somanna and Other Dignitaries Also Join Flag-off Ceremony New Vande Bharat Sleeper Express to Enhance Connectivity Between Bengaluru and Mumbai, Connecting India's IT and Startup Capital with Its Financial Capital: Sh. Ashwini Vaishnaw Modern Overnight Rail Connectivity to Benefit Professionals, Entrepreneurs, Students, Traders and Tourists Posted On: 01 NOV…
item.content:encoded:
Ministry of Railways
Union Minister for Railways Flags Off Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper Express Train
Union Ministers Pralhad Joshi, H. D. Kumaraswamy, Minister of State for Railways V. Somanna and Other Dignitaries Also Join Flag-off Ceremony
New Vande Bharat Sleeper Express to Enhance Connectivity Between Bengaluru and Mumbai, Connecting India's IT and Startup Capital with Its Financial Capital: Sh. Ashwini Vaishnaw
Modern Overnight Rail Connectivity to Benefit Professionals, Entrepreneurs, Students, Traders and Tourists
Posted On: 01 NOV 2026 7:21PM by PIB Delhi

Union Minister for Railways Shri Ashwini Vaishnaw today flagged off the SMVT Bengaluru-Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (CSMT), Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper Express in the presence of Union Minister Shri Pralhad Joshi, Union Minister Shri H. D. Kumaraswamy, Minister of State for Railways Shri V. Somanna, Minister of State Sushri Shobha Karandlaje and other dignitaries. The flag-off ceremony marks an important step towards strengthening modern overnight rail connectivity between two of India's leading metropolitan and economic centres.

Hon’ble Minister of Railways Shri @AshwiniVaishnaw, along with other dignitaries, flagged off the Bengaluru–Mumbai #VandeBharat_Sleeper train. https://t.co/2Gro8cQO5B

— Ministry of Railways (@RailMinIndia) November 1, 2026

The introduction of this next-generation sleeper train will provide passengers with an additional modern, comfortable and efficient travel option between Bengaluru and Mumbai. The service is expected to benefit professionals, entrepreneurs, business travellers, students, traders and tourists while strengthening connectivity across important regional centres in Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh and Maharashtra.

Following the introduction of Vande Bharat Sleeper services on the Howrah-Guwahati corridor in January 2026, and the flagging off of the Varanasi-New Delhi Vande Bharat Sleeper train yesterday, the Bengaluru-Mumbai service further expands the network of modern overnight rail travel and reinforces Indian Railways' commitment to passenger-centric mobility.

Highlighting the introduction of the Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper Express, Shri Vaishnaw said that the service would connect Bengaluru, the country's IT and startup capital, with Mumbai, its financial capital. The train will run via Anantapur and Guntakal in Andhra Pradesh; Raichur, Yadgir and Kalaburagi in Karnataka; and Solapur, Pune and Kalyan in Maharashtra, providing improved overnight connectivity to several parts of North Karnataka that previously lacked access to premium, world-class train services. He also announced that the next Vande Bharat Sleeper service for Karnataka would originate from Bengaluru, connect the northern parts of the state towards the Hubballi region and proceed towards Pune and Mumbai.

The Union Minister further announced that Vande Bharat services between Bengaluru and Mangaluru are expected to commence within the next few weeks, following the completion of electrification and successful testing on the route. The service will strengthen connectivity between Bengaluru and coastal Karnataka. He emphasised that the new service would provide faster, more comfortable and world-class rail connectivity to the region. He also highlighted the importance of modern railway infrastructure, technology-driven improvements and the expansion of high-speed services in strengthening passenger connectivity and supporting the economic development of Karnataka.

The Union Railway Minister Shri Ashwini Vaishnaw highlighted the expansion of high-speed rail connectivity in Karnataka and the development of new railway corridors to strengthen regional connectivity and promote economic integration. Highlighting the expected reduction in travel time, he stated that the Bengaluru-Chennai journey would take just 73 minutes, while Bengaluru-Hyderabad connectivity would be covered in approximately 2 hours and 10 minutes.

Union Minister Shri Pralhad Joshi appreciated the efforts of the Ministry of Railways in strengthening railway connectivity across Karnataka, particularly in North Karnataka. He highlighted the increased allocation of funds for railway infrastructure development and appreciated the significant progress made in railway development works in Karnataka. Shri Joshi emphasized that this robust investment has driven both infrastructure expansion and safety enhancements, pointing out that accident rates have plummeted from 135 to 16 following the rollout of the Kavach protection system, with a clear institutional target of achieving zero accidents. He also welcomed the introduction of new Vande Bharat services and the announcement of additional high-speed rail corridors, stating that these initiatives would improve passenger connectivity, enhance regional development and provide better access to modern rail services across Karnataka.

Union Minister Shri H. D. Kumaraswamy welcomed the introduction of the Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper service, the proposed Vande Bharat connectivity between Bengaluru and Mangaluru, and the planned rail connectivity linking Bengaluru with Pune. He noted that these initiatives would benefit not only the people of Karnataka but also the large number of migrant workers and families from states such as West Bengal, Assam and Bihar residing in Bengaluru, while improving passenger convenience and regional connectivity.

Union Minister of State for Railways Shri V. Somanna mentioned the significant transformation of railway infrastructure in Karnataka, with emphasis on expediting long-pending projects, strengthening rail connectivity and improving passenger amenities across the state. He highlighted that railway infrastructure development works worth approximately ₹52,000 crore are underway in the State. He appreciated the efforts of the Railway Minister in restoring train services, accelerating the construction of railway overbridges and underbridges, and modernising railway stations across Bengaluru, district headquarters and other important centres.

Connecting Two Major Economic and Commercial Centres

The new Vande Bharat Sleeper Express will establish an important overnight rail link between Bengaluru, a leading hub for information technology, innovation, education and entrepreneurship, and Mumbai, the country's financial and commercial capital.

Both metropolitan centres witness substantial movement of professionals, entrepreneurs, students, business travellers and families. The new service will offer passengers an additional convenient travel option, enabling them to undertake long-distance journeys overnight and reach their destination the following day.

The train will connect important stations along its route, including Anantapur, Guntakal, Raichur, Yadgir, Wadi, Kalaburagi, Solapur, Pune and Kalyan. This will strengthen connectivity across parts of Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh and Maharashtra, providing improved access to important commercial, educational and regional centres.

The train will depart SMVT Bengaluru at 19:45 hours and arrive at Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus, Mumbai, at 11:55 hours the following day. In the return direction, it will depart CSMT at 20:10 hours and reach SMVT Bengaluru at 12:00 hours the next day. The service will operate six days a week, except Monday in the Bengaluru-originating direction and Tuesday in the Mumbai-originating direction.

The overnight schedule will allow passengers to make more effective use of their daytime while travelling comfortably between the two metropolitan centres. Passengers from cities and towns along the route will also benefit from an additional modern rail travel option.

The flag-off of the Bengaluru-Mumbai Vande Bharat Sleeper Express marks another important milestone in Indian Railways' ongoing efforts to transform passenger transportation through modern infrastructure, advanced technology and improved connectivity. Indian Railways remains committed to developing a modern, efficient, safe and passenger-centric transportation network that supports India's economic growth and connects metropolitan centres with emerging regional hubs.

*****

Dharmendra Tewari/ Dr. Nayan Solanki/ Ritu Raj

item.content:encoded:
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
National Zoological Park marks 67th Foundation Day with Creative Outreach Activity and Bird Walk
Posted On: 01 NOV 2026 7:01PM by PIB Delhi

The National Zoological Park (NZP), New Delhi, celebrated its 67th Foundation Day on 01.11.2026 with an engaging doodle activity for visitors, reaffirming its commitment to wildlife conservation, biodiversity awareness and environmental education. The activity received an enthusiastic response, with approximately 1,500 visitors appreciating and participating in the initiative. It provided an interactive and creative platform, particularly for children and families, to express their ideas and connect with the importance of protecting wildlife and nature.

On the occasion, Dr. Sanjeet Kumar, Director (NZP) highlighted, “The 67th Foundation Day is an important milestone in the Park’s journey and an occasion to renew our commitment to wildlife conservation, animal welfare, biodiversity protection and public engagement. A modern zoo is not merely a place to see animals; it is a centre for conservation, learning, research and inspiration. Every visitor, especially every child can become an ambassador for nature through informed and responsible choices”. He invited citizens to connect with the National Zoological Park, learn about rich biodiversity and join in protecting wildlife and the natural world for future generations.

As part of its ongoing efforts to encourage public participation in biodiversity monitoring and wildlife conservation, the National Zoological Park organised the 19th edition of ‘Sunday Bird Walk @ NZP’ today, from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM. The walk was conducted under the expert guidance of Dr. Paritosh Ahmed, Ornithologist, with the support of dedicated volunteers.

A total of 18 participants, including bird enthusiasts, nature lovers, students, wildlife photographers and citizens interested in biodiversity, took part in the programme. During the walk, participants recorded 46 bird species and observed more than 500 individual birds in the designated area. The observations contributed to field-level biodiversity documentation and provided participants with a practical opportunity to engage in citizen science. The expert shared insights into bird ecology, behaviour and conservation, highlighting the role of birds in maintaining ecological balance including through natural pest control and their value as indicators of ecosystem health.

Addressing the participants, Director (NZP) emphasised that nature walks strengthen field-identification skills, deepen understanding of ecological relationships and food webs, support biodiversity documentation and foster a lasting appreciation of wildlife conservation. To ensure meaningful learning and effective participation, each Sunday Bird Walk is limited to 20–25 participants. Prior registration is mandatory, and places are allotted on a first-come, first-served basis. The registration form remains open from Monday to Friday each week. The link is available on the official website of the National Zoological Park and through the NZP Saathi mobile application.

*****

VM/SK

item.content:encoded:
Ministry of Defence
AIR MARSHAL MEHTAB SINGH DESWAL AVSM, VM TAKES OVER AS AIR OFFICER COMMANDING-IN-CHIEF EASTERN AIR COMMAND
Posted On: 01 NOV 2026 6:40PM by PIB Delhi

Air Marshal Mehtab Singh Deswal, AVSM VM assumed the appointment of Air Officer Commanding-in-Chief, Eastern Air Command, IAF on 01 Nov 26.

Air Marshal Deswal was commissioned in the flying branch of IAF as a fighter pilot on 14 Jun 1989. He has a flying experience of over 3200 hrs on a number of fighter aircraft He is a specialist in strike aircraft and Air Defence roles and a qualified Pilot Attack Instructor. The Air Officer is an alumnus of the National Defence Academy (NDA), and National Defence College.

During his career, he has held several field and staff appointments which includes Air Officer Commanding of two flying bases and Commanding Officer of a fighter squadron. He was posted at the Embassy of India in Pakistan as the Air Attaché. The Air Officer has also served as Director General (Weapon Systems) at Air HQs. Prior to taking over as AOC in-C, EAC, the air officer held the appointment of Senior Air Staff Officer (SASO) at HO SWAC.

In recognition of his distinguished service, Air Marshal Deswal has been awarded with Ati Vishisht Seva Medal and Vayu Sena Medal.

item.content:encoded:
President's Secretariat
PRESIDENT OF INDIA GRACES THE BALIDAN SHATABDI SAMAROH OF SWAMI SHRADDHANAND JI AT KURUKSHETRA
SWAMI SHRADDHANAND JI’S LIFE JOURNEY AND SACRIFICE ARE A SOURCE OF INSPIRATION FOR ALL: PRESIDENT DROUPADI MURMU
Posted On: 01 NOV 2026 6:10PM by PIB Delhi

The President of India, Smt. Droupadi Murmu graced Balidan Shatabdi Samaroh of Swami Shraddhanand Ji at Gurukul, Kurukshetra, Haryana today (November 1, 2026).

Speaking on the occasion, the President paid her tribute to Swami Shraddhanand Ji on the 100th anniversary of his martyrdom. She said that his life journey from Munshiram to Mahatma Munshiram and eventually to Swami Shraddhanand is deeply inspiring.

The President said that Swami Shraddhanand Ji had dedicated his life to the service of the Vedas and the upliftment of society. His life journey and sacrifice are a source of inspiration for all of us. 

The President said that Swami Shraddhanand Ji was a strong advocate of social unity. In an address delivered from the platform of the Jama Masjid in Delhi, he conveyed a message of mutual goodwill and national unity.

The President said that Swami Shraddhanand Ji believed that eradicating the stigma of untouchability and uplifting the Dalits were the most essential steps for the progress of India. In his view, the evil practice of untouchability was contrary to the core principles of the Vedic tradition.

The President said that Swami Shraddhanand Ji revived and strengthened the Gurukul system of education. This breathed new life into the stream of Indian education and culture. He made tireless efforts to revive the ancient Aryan system of education, a cause championed by Maharshi Dayanand Saraswati, the founder of the Arya Samaj.

The President said that the Centenary Year of Swami Shraddhanand Ji’s martyrdom serves as an opportunity to draw lessons from his inspiring life, his educational and social philosophy, and his dedication and sacrifice for the nation.

The President said that as we are moving towards the goal of a Viksit Bharat by the year 2047, it is of utmost importance that our citizens take pride in India’s rich cultural heritage while embracing modern knowledge, science, technology, innovation, and entrepreneurship. She expressed confidence that, drawing inspiration from the life of Swami Shraddhanand Ji, the youth of our country will contribute to building an educated, self-reliant, harmonious, and empowered India.

item.content:encoded:
Ministry of Coal
Coal India Marks 51 Glorious Years with Record-Breaking Performance in October 2026
Posted On: 01 NOV 2026 6:05PM by PIB Delhi

Coal India Limited (CIL) under the Ministry of Coal, the country’s leading coal producer, marked its 51st Foundation Day on 1st November 2026 on a remarkable note, registering a series of record-breaking achievements during October 2026. The company recorded its highest-ever monthly coal production and total coal supply, while also achieving the highest-ever monthly supply to the power sector.

During October 2026, CIL achieved a highest-ever total coal supply of 70.3 Million Tonnes (MT) in any month, surpassing the previous record of 69.4 MT achieved in March 2026. This represents a year-on-year growth of 19%.

Coal supply to the power sector also reached a new milestone, with CIL recording its highest-ever monthly supply of 57.1 MT to the power sector. The previous record stood at 56.5 MT, achieved in May 2024. The supply to the power sector registered a year-on-year growth of 19%.

The company also achieved a significant milestone in coal production, recording its highest-ever production of 67.2 MT during the month of October. This surpassed the previous record of 62.47 MT achieved in October 2024 and represents a year-on-year growth of 19%.

In another major achievement, railway coal evacuation witnessed record performance, with daily rake loading for the power sector reaching 310 rakes, the highest-ever achieved in any month. This surpassed the previous record of 302.8 rakes per day achieved in March 2025.

These remarkable achievements assume special significance as Coal India celebrates 51 glorious years of its existence and embarks on its 52nd year of service to the nation. Established on 1st November 1975, Coal India has witnessed several transformations and overcome numerous challenges over the past five decades, moving forward with unity, determination and collective resolve.

From an annual coal production of 79 MT in its first year of operations, Coal India has recorded sustained growth over the decades, increasing its production to 768 MT in FY 2025–26—representing an almost tenfold increase over the past five decades. The production target for FY 2026–27 has been fixed at 815 MT.

The record performance during October 2026 reflects Coal India’s continued focus on enhancing production, strengthening coal evacuation and ensuring adequate and reliable coal supplies to meet the country’s growing energy requirements.

As Coal India enters its 52nd year, the company remains committed to building upon its legacy of growth and transformation and contributing to India’s energy security and national development.

****

Shuhaib. T

item.content:encoded:
President's Secretariat
PRESIDENT OF INDIA GRACES THE ‘HIRAK JAYANTI’ CELEBRATION ON THE 60TH YEAR OF FORMATION OF THE STATE OF HARYANA AT KURUKSHETRA
THE PEOPLE OF HARYANA HAVE MADE MEANINGFUL CONTRIBUTIONS IN DIVERSE FIELDS, RANGING FROM THE FREEDOM STRUGGLE TO SOCIAL CHANGE, DEMOCRACY, LITERATURE, AND SCIENCE: PRESIDENT DROUPADI MURMU
Posted On: 01 NOV 2026 5:56PM by PIB Delhi

The President of India, Smt. Droupadi Murmu graced the ‘Hirak Jayanti’ celebration on the 60th year of the formation of the state of Haryana at Kurukshetra, Haryana today (November 1, 2026).

Addressing the gathering, the President congratulated the people of Haryana for making significant contributions to various facets of India’s journey of progress. She said that this land, which spread the eternal message of Bhagwan Krishna’s selfless action across the world, has also established numerous milestones of human achievement in the modern era. The people of Haryana have made meaningful contributions in diverse fields, ranging from the freedom struggle to social change, democracy, literature, and science.

The President was happy to note that over the last decade, Haryana has made significant progress across various dimensions of women's empowerment. She said that the national campaign ‘Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao’, which was launched from Panipat in January 2015, has proven to be a highly significant initiative toward women's empowerment. She was happy to note the increase in gender ratio at birth in 2025 as compared to 2014. She expressed confidence that through the concerted efforts of the Central and State governments, this ratio will reach a level of parity. She was also confident that the ongoing improvements in areas such as women’s health and girls’ education within the state will gain further momentum.

The President said that in the history of Indian sports, athletes from Haryana have achieved extraordinary success in prestigious international championships. She expressed her appreciation for the daughters of Haryana for making the nation proud with their remarkable achievements in sports.

The President said that Haryana is scaling new heights in its journey towards inclusive development. The President said that the land of Haryana has gifted the message of the Gita to the world. She wished that the message of Bhagwan Krishna would provide the strength and insight to every individual and institution which is contributing to Haryana’s development.

Shri Rijiju’s presence at the 108 Stupas event is an expression of shared spiritual and…
item.content:encoded:
Ministry of Minority Affairs
Shri Kiren Rijiju, Union Minister of Parliamentary Affairs and Minority Affairs, attends the raising of 108 Stupas in Bhutan
Posted On: 01 NOV 2026 5:45PM by PIB Delhi

Union Minister for Parliamentary Affairs and Minority Affairs, Shri Kiren Rijiju represented Government of India at the ceremony for raising and consecration of 108 Stupas in Gelephu Mindfulness City, Bhutan, led by His Majesty The King of Bhutan on 01 November 2026. Shri Rijiju’s presence at the 108 Stupas event is an expression of shared spiritual and cultural ties, and the close friendship between the peoples of India and Bhutan.


        The 108 Stupas project was conceived by His Majesty The King of Bhutan who also steered its implementation. In a single day, thousands of volunteers erected 108 Stupas, each 15 metres tall and separated by 108 metres on an 11.7 kilometre stretch along the Aie (Mau) River within Gelephu Mindfulness City near the border with Assam. The project aims to showcase Gelephu Mindfulness City as a prominent center of Vajrayana Buddhism, while simultaneously representing the values and culture of the Bhutanese people.           

His Majesty The King of Bhutan, Prime Minister of Bhutan and Minister Shri Rijiju offered prayers at the Stupa No.76, dedicated by His Majesty The King of Bhutan to Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi for his commitment and steadfast support to the Gelephu Mindfulness City. Shri Rijiju conveyed gratitude on behalf of Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi to His Majesty The King of Bhutan for the gesture of dedicating a Stupa as part of the Project.

During the visit to Bhutan from 31 October – 2 November 2026, Shri Rijiju received an audience with His Majesty The King of Bhutan, Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuck and met with the Prime Minister of Bhutan, Dasho Tshering Tobgay. The two sides appreciated the special friendship between the two nations and the healthy trend in bilateral cooperation in diverse areas such as development cooperation, trade, energy, investment, connectivity and cultural connections. Shri Rijiju reaffirmed India’s support for the visionary project of Gelephu Mindfulness City and its role in development of neighbouring areas in India together with Bhutan.

He will also address the…
item.content:encoded:
Prime Minister's Office
PM to Inaugurate Bharat Renewable Energy Summit & Expo 2026 on 2nd November
Theme of Summit - ‘Invest. Innovate. Inspire.’
Summit to Witness Participation from Over 130 Countries, 9 Country Partners and 40 Ministers
13 States and UTs to Showcase Renewable Energy Potential and Investment Opportunities
Posted On: 01 NOV 2026 5:43PM by PIB Delhi

Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi will inaugurate the Bharat Renewable Energy Summit & Expo 2026 on 2 November at around 4:30 PM at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi. He will also address the gathering on the occasion.

The four-day Summit will be held from 2 to 5 November 2026. The theme of the Summit  is ‘Invest. Innovate. Inspire.’

Bharat RE 2026 will attract participants from over 130 countries, including more than 40 Ministers, along with policymakers, investors, financial institutions and industry leaders. It will serve as a global platform for clean energy investment, industry engagement and technology partnerships. Australia, Denmark, the European Union, France, Germany, the Netherlands, Norway, Sweden and the United Kingdom will participate as Country Partners.

Thirteen States and Union Territories - Andhra Pradesh, Assam, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Delhi, Gujarat, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, Odisha, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh and West Bengal - will showcase their renewable energy potential, investment opportunities and manufacturing capabilities.

The Summit will be held alongside the 9th Session of the International Solar Alliance (ISA) Assembly and the 4th International Conference on Green Hydrogen (ICGH). While Bharat RE will focus on investment, industry and technology partnerships across the clean energy sector, the ISA Assembly will advance international cooperation in solar energy, including finance and institutional capacity. The ICGH will focus on green hydrogen technologies, investment and scale-up. Together, these three platforms will strengthen international cooperation and accelerate clean energy deployment.

Building on the legacy of RE-INVEST, India's flagship renewable energy investment summit, Bharat RE 2026 will provide an expanded platform for global engagement across the clean energy sector. The Summit will also host plenary sessions, ministerial discussions, CEO roundtables and country and state sessions, alongside business-to-business, business-to-government and government-to-government engagements to promote investment, partnerships and project development.  The Expo will feature over 400 exhibitors showcasing advanced technologies, Indian manufacturing capabilities and clean energy solutions across solar and wind power, green hydrogen, energy storage and other emerging areas.

item.content:encoded:
Ministry of Defence
AIR CHIEF MARSHAL ASHUTOSH DIXIT ASSUMES CHARGE AS THE 29TH CHIEF OF THE AIR STAFF; UNVEILS 'VAYU' AS GUIDING VISION FOR THE INDIAN AIR FORCE
Posted On: 01 NOV 2026 5:18PM by PIB Delhi

Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit PVSM AVSM VM VSM, as the 29th Chief of the Air Staff of the Indian Air Force, on 01 November 2026, commenced his tenure by paying homage at the National War Memorial to the bravehearts who made the supreme sacrifice in service of the Nation. This was followed by a ceremonial Guard of Honour at Air Force Station New Delhi.

An Experimental Test Pilot and Qualified Flying Instructor, Air Chief Marshal Dixit has over 3,500 hours of flying experience. He has held several key operational and strategic appointments, including Chief of Integrated Defence Staff to the Chairman Chiefs of Staff Committee (CISC), HQ IDS, Air Officer Commanding-in-Chief, Central Air Command, and Vice Chief of the Air Staff.

Chief in his opening address, outlined his vision and priorities for the Indian Air Force, the Chief of the Air Staff coined the guiding theme ‘VAYU', articulating four distinct pillars that will shape the IAF's future trajectory.

V - Vigilance, Victory and Readiness: Maintaining the highest state of operational preparedness across all formations, while restoring combat strength to sanctioned levels.

A - Aatmanirbharta: Accelerating indigenous capabilities across platforms, sensors weapons and technologies, with a focus on operational self-reliance and sustained combat capability.           

Y - Yukti: Harnessing ingenuity and innovation in doctrine, technology and operational procedures, including Al-enabled command and control, counter-     drone capabilities, resilience and emerging operational domains.

U - Unity of Effort: Strengthening jointness with the Army, Navy and national agencies, in consonance with the national vision of JAI - Jointness, Aatmanirbharta and Innovation.

Through the 'VAYU' vision, the Chief of the Air Staff has articulated a clear direction for an operationally ready, technologically advanced, self-reliant and seamlessly integrated Indian Air Force, committed to safeguarding the nation's interests and deterring conflict through credible air power.

***

JS/VK/SM

(Release ID: 2331212)

The trials, scheduled to run from November to December 2026, will allow eligible Indian nationals holding e-passports to use the Digi Yatra at designated airport…
item.content:encoded:
Ministry of Civil Aviation
Digi Yatra Begins International Passenger Trials at Seven Airports
Trials to collect passenger feedback for wider rollout in 2027
Posted On: 01 NOV 2026 4:48PM by PIB Delhi

Digi Yatra has commenced trials for international passengers at seven airports across India, marking a further step in the adoption of digital technology in the country’s aviation sector. The trials, scheduled to run from November to December 2026, will allow eligible Indian nationals holding e-passports to use the Digi Yatra at designated airport touchpoints while travelling on select international flights operated by Air India and IndiGo.

The trials are being conducted at Delhi, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Cochin, Mumbai, Chennai and Amritsar airports. Eligible passengers will be able to use the facility at terminal entry points, Security Hold Areas (SHA) and boarding gates, wherever the required infrastructure is available. Feedback received during the trial period will inform the planning of a wider rollout in 2027.

To access the facility, eligible Indian nationals must create an e-passport-based Verifiable Credential (VC) through the Digi Yatra mobile application. The process involves scanning the Machine Readable Zone (MRZ) of the e-passport, reading the embedded chip using the Near Field Communication (NFC) feature of a compatible smartphone, capturing a selfie and verifying the details. The credential is stored in the passenger’s Digi Yatra wallet on the device and can be used at airport touchpoints enabled for the trials.

The facility is intended to complement, and not replace, existing travel processes. Passengers must continue to carry their travel documents and complete all mandatory airline document checks, immigration procedures and other applicable travel formalities.

The Digi Yatra’s adoption continues to expand across India’s aviation network. The platform has over 26.5 million users and has enabled more than 110 million journeys across 39 domestic airports, serving domestic airlines. A further 25 domestic airports are planned to be covered by 2027.

The Ministry of Civil Aviation remains committed to leveraging technology to improve airport operations and facilitate seamless air travel, in line with the Government of India’s vision of Digital India and Ease of Flying.

***

Divyanshu Kumar

item.content:encoded:
Ministry of Home Affairs
Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah attends Diamond Jubilee Foundation Day celebrations of Chandigarh Police and graced the President’s Colour Conferment Ceremony of Chandigarh Police as the Chief Guest
Heartiest congratulations to all police personnel and people of Chandigarh on the occasion of Chandigarh Foundation Day and conferment of President’s Colour on Chandigarh Police on its Diamond Jubilee
Conferment of President’s Colour on Chandigarh Police is a recognition of its six decades of service, dedication and sensitivity
Despite its proximity to Punjab, Chandigarh will be the first region in the country to become drug-free
Since 1966, Chandigarh Police has scripted a golden chapter in the history of policing across the country by safeguarding the heart of North India
During the era of terrorism, the Chandigarh Police demonstrated the pinnacle of valor, playing a leading role in ensuring the safety not only of Chandigarh but of the entire nation
Chandigarh has transformed a justice system once notorious for “Tareekh Pe Tareekh”, achieving an 85% conviction rate and an average case disposal time of just 140 days
Chandigarh’s beat policing system serves as a model for police forces across the country, it has established a system where citizens do not even need to visit police stations to seek assistance
Despite being the city with the highest number of vehicles per capita, I have never witnessed a traffic jam in Chandigarh
Chandigarh Police ranks second in the country in terms of response time, with the addition of 141 new vehicles today, I am confident that it will secure the first position nationwide next year
Chandigarh Police has set a national record by filing online charge sheets in 7,590 out of the 8,206 cases registered since August 4, 2024
I appeal to Chandigarh Police to make the fight against drug abuse its priority, we can move towards a Viksit Bharat only by freeing the younger generation from the menace of drugs
Posted On: 01 NOV 2026 4:30PM by PIB Delhi

Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah today attended the Diamond Jubilee celebrations marking the establishment of Chandigarh Police and graced the President’s Colour Award Ceremony of Chandigarh Police as the Chief Guest. Several dignitaries, including the Governor of Punjab and Administrator of Chandigarh, Shri Gulab Chand Kataria, were present on the occasion.

Addressing the gathering on the occasion, Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah said that the President’s Colour awarded to Chandigarh Police today is a recognition of the force’s six decades of service, dedication and sensitivity. He said that making the supreme sacrifice in the line of duty is a matter of pride for any martyr and also a matter of pride for the organisation to which the personnel belong. Shri Amit Shah said that from 1966 to the present day, Chandigarh Police has continuously worked tirelessly to protect this remarkable city, thereby writing a golden chapter in its history.

Shri Amit Shah said that 141 new vehicles are being inducted into the Chandigarh Police fleet today. This will significantly strengthen rapid response, intensive patrolling, mobility, technology and modern policing. He said that Chandigarh Police currently ranks second in the country in terms of response time and, with the addition of 141 new vehicles, it will rank first nationwide.

Union Home Minister said that the President’s Colour is awarded to a force in recognition of more than 15 years of service, taking into account the discipline and dedication of its personnel. He said that over the past 60 years, Chandigarh Police has successfully worked towards safeguarding the entire country, serving as a vital force in the heart of the northern region. Shri Amit Shah said that Chandigarh, situated at the foothills of the Shivalik range, is regarded as one of India's most well-planned cities. However, when the country witnessed an era of terrorism, Chandigarh too was not spared. During that period, Chandigarh Police demonstrated exceptional valour and courage and, through its spirit of bravery, service and good governance, worked to protect not only Chandigarh but the entire region from terrorism.

Shri Amit Shah said that on November 1, 1966, Chandigarh was made a Union Territory and designated as the joint capital of both states. Coordinating closely with the Haryana Police and Punjab Police, Chandigarh Police has effectively managed the tri-city region. He said that the police force, comprising more than 6,000 personnel, has set benchmarks across the country through the exemplary discharge of duties by its Crime Wing, Operations Cell, Security Wing, Traffic Police and PCR units. Shri Shah said, Chandigarh has transformed a justice system once notorious for “Tareekh Pe Tareekh”, achieving an 85% conviction rate and an average case disposal time of just 140 days.

Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation Shri Amit Shah said that policing in our country has largely remained focused on tackling terrorism, drugs, cybercrime and maintaining law and order. However, facilitating ease of access to services for citizens is also an important responsibility of the police. He said that through its Beat Policing App and this model, Chandigarh Police has successfully implemented an excellent system on the ground, ensuring that citizens do not have to visit police stations for their needs. Shri Amit Shah said that Chandigarh has the highest number of vehicles per capita in the country, yet the city does not face the problem of traffic congestion.

Shri Amit Shah said that Chandigarh Police has a Quick Response Time (QRT) of 10 minutes, while the average time taken by the police to reach a location is 4 minutes. Chandigarh was the first to introduce the Beat Policing system after 2015. He said that the three new criminal laws were also introduced by Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi in Chandigarh, marking the country's transition away from the three punitive laws enacted by the British. Shri Shah said that now that we have resolved to build a drug-free India, Chandigarh will be the first city in the country to become drug-free. He said that following the implementation of the new criminal laws, Chandigarh Police has increased the conviction rate in NDPS cases, securing the conviction of 93 per cent of accused persons and sending them to jail. This campaign against drugs and gangsters is a major achievement of Chandigarh Police. He said that from August 4, 2024, till date, 8,206 FIRs have been registered in Chandigarh, of which Chandigarh Police has filed charge sheets online in 7,590 cases. The police have also ensured convictions in 85 per cent of cases by improving the conviction rate. Shri Amit Shah said that this serves as a model for all police forces across the country, demonstrating that effective implementation of the new criminal laws can ensure the conviction of 85 per cent of offenders. He said that police services had earned a negative reputation due to the old laws, under which people were often deprived of justice for generations. Today, with a conviction rate of 85 per cent, Chandigarh has achieved an average time of just 140 days for securing the conviction of accused persons.

Union Home Minister said that the Government of India has provided Chandigarh with 2152 Artificial Intelligence-enabled CCTV cameras. He said that Chandigarh Police has won a total of 145 medals at the All India Police Duty Meet, including 35 gold, 38 silver and 72 bronze medals. Shri Amit Shah said that Chandigarh Police is also at the forefront of taking welfare measures for its personnel. Financial assistance of ₹8,000 per month is being provided to 130 families of widowed police personnel. Educational and sports scholarships amounting to approximately ₹2.25 crore are also being provided. He further said that 154 new vehicles were inducted into the force in 2026, while the housing satisfaction rate stands at 48 per cent.

*****

item.content:encoded:
Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment
Ministry Of Social Justice And Empowerment Issues Factual Report With Regard To The Claim—Appearing In A Report Published In The Central Chronicle (Bhopal) On October 31, 2026
Claim That MAPCET Made Payments Amounting To Crores Based On Placements Without Verifying The Placement Data, Is Entirely Incorrect And Baseless
Posted On: 01 NOV 2026 3:28PM by PIB Delhi

The Ministry of Social Justice And Empowerment has issued a factual report with regard to the claim—appearing in a report published in The Central Chronicle (Bhopal), on October 31, 2026. 

The claim with regard to Madhya Pradesh Council for Employment and Training (MAPCET), having made payments amounting to crores based on placements without verifying the placement data, is entirely incorrect and baseless.

The factual report is attached herewith, for publishing the same with accuracy and factual context:

FACTUAL REPORT REGARDING THE NEWS ITEM PUBLISHED IN
CENTRAL CHRONICLE, BHOPAL, ON 31 OCTOBER 2026

The Office of the Commissioner, Scheduled Caste Development Department, sanctioned an amount of Rs. 3,241.37 lakh for skill development training under the “Special Central Assistance for Scheduled Caste Sub-Plan” head. Against this amount, a total of Rs. 2,945.37 lakh was made available to the Madhya Pradesh Employment and Training Council (MAPCET) during 2021–22. This amount comprised Rs. 1,296.00 lakh (vide Order No. 4695 dated 26 November 2021) and Rs. 1,649.37 lakh (vide Order No. 10283 dated 25 March 2022).

The Madhya Pradesh Council for Employment and Training (MAPCET) issued a request for proposal (RFP) for the training of beneficiaries from below-poverty-line (BPL) families belonging to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category for the year 2021–22. Following the selection process, contracts were signed with 34 training provider organisations, and work orders were subsequently issued to them. Of these, six organisations did not commence the work.

After the work orders were issued by MAPCET, 28 institutions provided training to 4,952 trainees. The training programmes conducted by the Council comply with the standards prescribed by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE), Government of India. All training activities are managed through a dedicated portal, which facilitates trainee registration, daily attendance tracking, and the uploading of assessment and placement data.

Under Clause 2.1.1 of Schedule IV to the Gazette notification issued by the Government of India, Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE), Notification No. 349 dated 4 December 2020, the payment criteria for training providers conducting training in batch mode are as follows:

No.

Instalment

Percentage of batch amount

Milestone

1

First

30%

Commencement of training

2

Second

40%

Successful completion of certification. Payment is made for the number of candidates certified, after adjustment of advance payments.

3

Third

30%

Achievement of 70% verified employment: continuous employment for three months, with desk verification and placement verification in accordance with standard norms.

The first and second instalments have been paid to the training provider organisations in accordance with the criteria and contractual terms prescribed by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE), Government of India.

The first instalment is paid when a training batch commences, following physical verification of the trainees. The second instalment is paid after the training has been completed and the trainees have been assessed.

The assessment is conducted by entities designated by the National Council for Vocational Education and Training (NCVET). Trainees must have attended at least 70 per cent of the training to be eligible for assessment. The first and second instalments have been disbursed on this basis.

The post-training placement information submitted by the training provider institutions in hard-copy form is based on job offers or offer letters. Such submissions do not constitute the basis for releasing the third instalment. To qualify for the third instalment, institutions must upload placement details to the portal in accordance with the prescribed criteria. Only then can the portal generate payment claims for the third instalment. As no such payment claims have been generated for any of these institutions, no third-instalment payments have been made.

The claim made in the news report published in Central Chronicle, Bhopal, on 31 October 2026—that MAPCET disbursed crores of rupees on the basis of placements without verifying the placement data—is entirely incorrect and baseless.

• The third instalment, which is conditional upon placement, has not been paid to any of the institutions. Therefore, the question of tracking such placements for the purpose of releasing this instalment does not arise.

• The institutions have received only the first and second instalments, neither of which is linked to placement. Accordingly, placement or placement tracking is not relevant to the payments already made.

The third instalment will be paid when candidates take up employment after completing their training. The organisation is currently facilitating placements.

*****

Eng-Reb: TAR/KV/GA/RK-

item.content:encoded:
Ministry of Mines
Shri Dinesh V. Ganvir Takes Charge as Director General of GSI; Reaffirms Focus on Mineral Security, Scientific Excellence and Technological Advancement
Posted On: 01 NOV 2026 3:10PM by PIB Delhi

Shri Dinesh Vitthalrao Ganvir has assumed the charge as the 55th Director General of the Geological Survey of India (GSI), an attached office of the Ministry of Mines, Government of India. With more than three decades of experience spanning geological investigations, mineral exploration, engineering geology and institutional leadership, Shri Dinesh V. Ganvir brings to the office extensive scientific, technical and administrative experience.

Shri Dinesh V. Ganvir joined the Geological Survey of India on 1st July 1994, following the completion of his Master's degree in Geology from RTMNU University, Nagpur. Over a career spanning more than 32 years, he has served in a range of scientific, technical and administrative positions across GSI's Central Region, North-Eastern Region and Northern Region. Immediately prior to assuming the charge of Director General, he was serving as Additional Director General and Head of Department, Central Region, Nagpur, while also holding the additional charge of National Mission Head-II.

His contributions span geological mapping, mineral exploration, engineering geology and multidisciplinary geoscientific studies. His assignments include thematic mapping in the Western Bastar Craton; gold and diamond exploration in the Sakoli Fold Belt of Maharashtra; and geoscientific studies associated with the conservation of the UNESCO World Heritage Sites of Bhimbetka Rock Shelters and Ellora Caves. He has represented GSI at several international forums, including the India–Peru Joint Working Group, the Russia–India Mining Sub-Group and IMARC 2022 in Australia.

In leadership assignments, particularly as  National Mission Head-II, Shri Dinesh V. Ganvir was associated with the planning and monitoring of multidisciplinary field programmes and nationwide mineral exploration, including spearheading a five fold jump in investigations for critical and strategic minerals in recent time and preparation of geological reports and exploration blocks for mineral auctions process in line with GSI's national mandate. During this tenure, he made significant contributions to the nation’s mineral exploration and resource development initiatives, facilitating the handover of 359 Geological Reports and 377 Geological Memorandums. Of these, 202 blocks pertained to critical minerals, of which 40 have been successfully auctioned, while 56 blocks under the Exploration Licence (EL) regime were handed over, of which 11 have been auctioned, under Tranche I & II.

On assuming charge of Director General, Shri Dinesh V. Ganvir underscored the importance of enhancing the scientific depth, relevance and national impact of GSI's work. A key priority will be to intensify exploration for critical and strategic minerals through integrated geoscientific investigations, advanced mineral prospectivity mapping and systematic generation of scientifically robust, auction-ready mineral blocks. These efforts will support the country's objectives of strengthening mineral security, reducing import dependence and advancing the vision of Atmanirbhar Bharat.

He also emphasised the need to harness emerging technologies and advanced data analytics in conjunction with rigorous field-based investigations. The integration of modern geoscientific tools and methods is expected to improve the precision and efficiency of exploration. Strengthening laboratory infrastructure, upgrading analytical capabilities and offshore exploration will also be important areas of focus.

Beyond mineral exploration, GSI will continue to strengthen its contributions to fundamental geoscientific research, landslide early warning, glacial and cryospheric studies, major infrastructure projects and hazard assessment. These areas of work are vital to informed policymaking, infrastructure planning, disaster preparedness and sustainable development. The emphasis will be on generating reliable, science-based inputs that address the country's evolving developmental and societal priorities.

Emphasising institutional development, Shri Dinesh V. Ganvir highlighted the need to empower scientific personnel, foster innovation, recognise merit and performance, and strengthen coordination among National Missions, Regional offices and State Units. Efficient resource utilisation and timely delivery of high-quality scientific outputs will remain central to enhancing GSI's effectiveness.

Under his leadership, GSI will seek to build on its rich scientific legacy while responding to the demands of a rapidly evolving geoscientific and technological landscape. With a renewed focus on scientific excellence, innovation, collaboration and outcome-oriented work, the organisation will continue to play a pivotal role in strengthening India's mineral resource base, supporting infrastructure development, enhancing disaster resilience and contributing to the national vision of Viksit Bharat 2047.

***

Prajith Kumar MV

item.content:encoded:
Ministry of Labour & Employment
EPFO's 74-Year Journey Built on Trust, Service and Commitment to Workers: Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya
"Seva is Our Sanskaar”: Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya Urges EPFO Officials to Place Worker Welfare at the Heart of Innovation
Dr. Mandaviya Launches EPFO Services through WhatsApp
Launch of Automatic Settlement of Eligible Inoperative EPF Accounts; benefits extended to one lakh accounts involving ₹5 crore
EPFO's 74th Foundation Day Celebration showcases a Journey of Transformation, Compassion and Citizen-Centric Governance
Posted On: 01 NOV 2026 3:09PM by PIB Delhi

Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) celebrated its 74th Foundation Day today at Dr. Ambedkar International Centre, New Delhi, marking its journey from a statutory provident fund organisation to one of India's foremost social security institutions, with a renewed commitment to technology-enabled service delivery, compassion in governance and the welfare of millions of workers and pensioners.

The celebration was presided over by Dr. Mansukh Mandviya, Union Minister for Labour & Employment and Youth & Sports Affairs and Chairman, Central Board of Trustees (EPF). Shri Chandra Bhushan Kumar, Secretary, Ministry of Labour & Employment and Shri Ramesh Krishnamurthi, Central Provident Fund Commissioner, Members of the Central Board of Trustees, workers, employers and other stakeholders also graced the occasion.

Addressing the gathering, Union Minister for Labour & Employment and Youth Affairs & Sports, Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya highlighted that over its 74-year journey, EPFO has emerged as a trusted institution for the workforce of the country. He noted that the trust reposed in the Organisation is reflected in the ₹32 lakh crore corpus accumulated through contributions from more than 8 crore members, made possible by the dedication, hard work and commitment of the EPFO workforce.

Emphasising that social security must be driven by human sensitivity, Dr. Mandaviya stressed that every concern and grievance of workers must be addressed with compassion and empathy, viewing each worker with the respect and dignity they deserve as nation-builders. Commending the relentless efforts behind technological transformations like CITES 2.01, he called upon every official to focus on the welfare of the worker at the last mile. He urged officials to take inspiration from the ‘Panch Pran’ articulated by Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi. "Seva is our sanskaar," Dr. Mandaviya underlined, and encouraged all to contribute towards accomplishing the goal of Viksit Bharat.

The Union Minister urged officials to focus on worker-centric innovations across domains in the run-up to EPFO's 75th year, adapting, building resilience, and evolving processes in tandem with changing times. He also extended Diwali greetings and wished for the light of success and prosperity in the lives of all EPFO officials, members and beneficiaries.

The Secretary, Ministry of Labour & Employment, Dr. Chandra Bhushan Kumar stated that EPFO, in over seven decades of service to the nation, has laid the foundation of and strengthened India's social security framework, creating a model worth emulating for coming generations. He emphasised that social protection and labour reforms must reach not just the organised sector, but unorganised sector workers at the last mile, noting that EPFO sets an example of how to achieve this through institutionalised processes. Observing that the day provides an opportunity to reflect on how far we have come and how far we have to go, he stressed that reform is a continuous process and requires constant evolution in the current digital age in order to effectively solve the common man's problems. He called upon officials associated with these reforms to adapt their mindset and perspective in tandem, prioritizing accessibility and ease of living for beneficiaries as collective efforts continue toward attaining the goal of Viksit Bharat @2047.

In his address, Central Provident Fund Commissioner reflected on EPFO's 74-year journey, from the founding commitment of 1952 to its present role as a national social security institution serving approximately 8 crore contributory members and 85 lakh pensioners, while safeguarding a retirement corpus of nearly Rs. 32 lakh crore. He acknowledged the contribution of officers and employees across the country, whose efforts have sustained service delivery while the Organisation has undergone significant technological and administrative transformation. Highlighting the need to make EPFO more accessible, reliable and humane, he emphasised that institutional trust is built through every claim settled, every pension delivered and every family supported during difficult times. He reiterated that the ultimate measure of EPFO's success must be the confidence and security experienced by its members and pensioners.

The impact of EPFO's technological transformation through CITES 2.01 was also showcased. A significant improvement in claim settlement was highlighted, with the average settlement time declining to 2.57 days in October 2026. The improvement reflects the Organisation's continuing efforts to make access to provident fund savings faster and more convenient for members.

Major initiatives and their benefits for EPF subscribers and employers

1. EPFO Services through WhatsApp

EPF subscribers will be able to access their PF balance, latest five transactions and passbook information through EPFO's verified WhatsApp service, besides receiving personalised guidance and assistance in completing PMVBRY-related requirements. This will make routine services accessible through a familiar mobile platform and reduce the need to visit EPFO offices.

2. Launch of Automatic Settlement of Eligible Inoperative EPF Accounts

Subscribers having Aadhaar-verified inoperative EPF accounts with balances up to ₹1,000 will not be required to file individual claims. EPFO will initiate settlement automatically after prescribed identity and bank-account verification, facilitating transfer of eligible dues to rightful beneficiaries. Approximately one lakh accounts involving ₹5 crore are expected to benefit.

Publications released and excellence recognised

Seven publications were released on the occasion, reflecting EPFO's commitment to knowledge creation, institutional learning, legal awareness and compassionate governance:

1. EPFO State Profile 2026: Presents EPFO’s geographical presence, state-wise coverage, membership, establishments, claims and pensioner statistics.

2. Compendium of Judgements 2026: Compiles important judicial pronouncements on social security legislation to facilitate informed and consistent decision-making.

3. Kendra Nidhi – Hindi Magazine 2026–27: Showcases the literary and creative contributions of EPFO officers and employees and promotes Hindi.

4. Beyond the Desk, Beyond the Ordinary: Celebrates the diverse talents and accomplishments of EPFO personnel beyond their professional responsibilities.

5. Reimagining Governance: Discourse for Excellence (RGDE): Documents insights from the dialogue series initiated by PDUNASS on ethical leadership, compassionate governance and institutional transformation.

6. Shasan Vidhi Mein Karuna (Compassion in Governance): Presents 83 real-life case studies from 62 Regional Offices, showcasing empathy and innovative approaches in resolving members’ grievances.

7. The Indian Journal of Social Security – Volume 1, 2026: Features research contributions by EPFO officers on contemporary issues in social security, labour markets, digital transformation and pension administration.

The Bhavishya Nidhi Awards 2026 were presented to recognise outstanding contributions by Regional Offices, Zonal Offices, individual officers and employees. The awards covered excellence in regional and district-level performance, grievance management, pension services, death claim settlement and PRAYAAS, PMVBRY implementation, technological innovation, training, publicity, cleanliness, exempted establishments and sports. The awards recognised the dedication, innovation and commitment of the EPFO workforce in strengthening service delivery and institutional excellence.

The 74th Foundation Day reaffirmed a common vision emerging from the addresses of the leadership: that the transformation of EPFO must ultimately translate into greater security, dignity and confidence for every worker and pensioner. As the Organisation moves forward, its endeavour will be to combine technological advancement with human sensitivity, wider social security coverage with dependable service, and institutional efficiency with compassion in governance.

The journey of EPFO is not merely a story of institutional growth; it is a continuing commitment to ensure that the fruits of a worker's years of labour translate into security, dignity and peace of mind for the worker and the family.

 

**********

Rini Choudhury / Aishwarya Asthana

Lok Sabha Secretariat
LOK SABHA SPEAKER TO INAUGURATE CONFERENCE OF CHAIRPERSONS OF PUBLIC ACCOUNTS COMMITTEES OF PARLIAMENT OF INDIA AND STATE/UT LEGISLATURES IN THIRUVANANTHAPURAM
CHIEF MINISTER OF KERALAM, DEPUTY CHAIRMAN OF RAJYA SABHA, SPEAKER AND DEPUTY SPEAKER OF KERALAM LEGISLATIVE ASSEMBLY AND CHAIRPERSONS OF PUBLIC ACCOUNTS COMMITTEES TO GRACE THE INAUGURAL SESSION
CONFERENCE TO DELIBERATE ON THE THEME: ‘AUDIT, ACCOUNTABILITY AND GOOD GOVERNANCE – THE EVOLVING ROLE OF THE PAC’
LOK SABHA SPEAKER TO DELIVER THE VALEDICTORY ADDRESS ON 4 NOVEMBER 2026
Posted On: 01 NOV 2026 2:38PM by PIB Delhi

Lok Sabha Speaker Shri Om Birla will inaugurate the Conference of Chairpersons of Public Accounts Committees (PACs) of Parliament of India and State/UT Legislatures at Thiruvananthapuram, Keralam, on Tuesday, 3 November 2026.

The inaugural session will be graced by the Chief Minister of Keralam, Shri V. D. Satheesan; Deputy Chairman, Rajya Sabha, Shri Harivansh; Speaker, Keralam Legislative Assembly, Shri Thiruvanchoor Radhakrishnan; and Chairperson, Public Accounts Committee of the Keralam Legislative Assembly, Shri K. N. Balagopal, who will also address the gathering.

Chairperson, Public Accounts Committee of Parliament, Shri K. C. Venugopal, will deliver the Welcome Address, while Deputy Speaker, Keralam Legislative Assembly, Smt. Shanimol Usman, will propose the Vote of Thanks. Chairpersons and Members of Public Accounts Committees of Parliament and State/UT Legislatures, along with other distinguished dignitaries, will participate in the Conference.

The two-day Conference will deliberate on the theme, ‘Audit, Accountability and Good Governance – The Evolving Role of the PAC’. The deliberations will provide an important platform for sharing experiences, exchanging best practices and exploring ways to further strengthen the role of Public Accounts Committees in ensuring legislative oversight of public expenditure and promoting transparency, accountability and financial discipline in governance.

As key parliamentary institutions entrusted with examining public expenditure and ensuring that public funds are utilised in accordance with legislative intent, Public Accounts Committees play a vital role in upholding the principles of accountability and responsible governance. The Conference is expected to foster constructive dialogue on emerging challenges in public financial management, the evolving audit landscape and the need to further enhance the effectiveness of legislative scrutiny.

The Conference will conclude on Wednesday, 4 November 2026, with the Valedictory Session to be addressed by Lok Sabha Speaker Shri Om Birla. The Speaker, Keralam Legislative Assembly, and the Chairperson, Public Accounts Committee of Parliament, will also address the session. The Deputy Speaker, Keralam Legislative Assembly, will deliver the Welcome Address, while the Chairperson, Public Accounts Committee of the Keralam Legislative Assembly, will propose the Vote of Thanks.

Lok Sabha Speaker Shri Om Birla with Chairperson and Members of Public Accounts Committee in Parliament House on 15 October 2026

***

item.content:encoded:
Vice President's Secretariat
Vice-President Inaugurates National Organ Transplant Games 2026; Calls Organ Donation a ‘Mahadaan’
Vice-President Highlights Transformative Power of Organ Donation, Felicitates World Transplant Games Medalists
Vice-President Calls for Greater Awareness of Organ Donation, Dispelling Myths and Misconceptions
570 Transplant Recipients and Donors Set World Record for Largest Tadasana Congregation at National Organ Transplant Games 2026
Posted On: 01 NOV 2026 2:34PM by PIB Delhi

The Vice-President of India Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan, today inaugurated the National Organ Transplant Games 2026 at Talkatora Stadium, New Delhi.

Vice-President Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan inaugurated the National Organ Transplant Games 2026 at Talkatora Stadium, New Delhi today. The Vice-President paid his deepest respects to deceased organ donors and their families, whose selfless decisions give others a second chance at life. He described the Games as a celebration of courage, determination, compassion and the precious gift of life. Shri Prataprao Jadhav, Union Minister of State for Health and Family Welfare; Ms. Bansuri Swaraj, Member of Parliament, Lok Sabha; and other dignitaries were present during the occasion. @mpprataprao @BansuriSwaraj @MoHFW_INDIA

— Vice-President of India (@VPIndia) November 1, 2026

Addressing the gathering, the Vice-President described the Games as a celebration of courage, determination, compassion and the precious gift of life. He congratulated the Renal Care Foundation, Sir Ganga Ram Hospital and the National Organ and Tissue Transplant Organization (NOTTO), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, for this important initiative.

Highlighting India’s civilisational ethos of selfless service, the Vice-President recalled the sacrifice of Maharshi Dadhichi as a timeless symbol of giving for the greater good. He described organ donation as a ‘Mahadaan’, through which hope can endure even in the face of loss.

The Vice-President noted that the organ donation movement in India has received significant impetus from the consistent emphasis placed on the subject by Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi through his ‘Mann Ki Baat’ addresses.

Describing the Games as much more than a sporting event, the Vice-President said they celebrate the resilience of transplant recipients and demonstrate the life-transforming power of modern medicine. He commended the participants for their courage, discipline and sporting spirit, noting that their achievements inspire hope among those awaiting transplantation.

The Vice-President paid his deepest respects to deceased organ donors and their families, whose selfless decisions give others a second chance at life. He also appreciated living donors for exemplifying the finest values of love and compassion. He emphasised that one deceased organ donor can save up to eight lives.

Calling for greater awareness about organ donation, the Vice-President stressed the need to dispel myths and misconceptions, encourage informed decisions and motivate people to share their wishes with their families. He said the National Organ Transplant Games provide an exceptional platform to advance this mission by bringing together transplant recipients, donors, healthcare professionals and their families.

During the programme, the Vice-President released the ‘Zindagi Dobara’ Calendar and felicitated medal winners of the World Transplant Games 2025, held in Dresden, Germany.

He also witnessed an attempt at a world record featuring 570 transplant recipients and donors performing Tadasana together. Following the successful attempt, the organisers were presented with a certificate by the World Book of Records, New Delhi, for the “Largest congregation of Transplant recipients and donors performing Tadasana”.

The Vice-President joined the gathering in taking the Organ Donation Pledge and witnessed exhibition matches in Kabaddi, Table Tennis and Badminton.

Concluding his address, the Vice-President called upon everyone to make organ donation a powerful expression of shared humanity and to work towards a society where more patients receive transplants and fewer lives are lost waiting for organs.

The programme was attended by Shri Prataprao Jadhav, Union Minister of State for Health and Family Welfare; Ms. Bansuri Swaraj, Member of Parliament, Lok Sabha; Dr. D. S. Rana, Chairman, Sir Ganga Ram Trust Society and Chief Patron, NOTG 2026; Dr. A. K. Bhalla, Organising Chairman, NOTG 2026; and Dr. Anil Kumar, Director, NOTTO, among other dignitaries.

*****

item.content:encoded:
Prime Minister's Office
Prime Minister extends greetings to the people of Tamil Nadu on Tamil Nadu Day
Posted On: 01 NOV 2026 12:49PM by PIB Delhi

The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has extended greetings to the people of Tamil Nadu on the occasion of Tamil Nadu Day, today. Shri Modi said that the hardworking and enterprising people of Tamil Nadu have made outstanding contributions to India’s progress. From manufacturing, automobiles and textiles to electronics, space technology, healthcare and emerging industries, the state has distinguished itself through innovation, skill and industrial excellence.

"The people of Tamil Nadu take immense pride in their cultural identity and traditions. Tamil culture has enriched our nation’s civilisational journey in innumerable ways", Shri Modi remarked.

The Prime Minister posted on X:

Warm greetings to the people of Tamil Nadu on the special occasion of Tamil Nadu Day!

The hardworking and enterprising people of Tamil Nadu have made outstanding contributions to India’s progress. From manufacturing, automobiles and textiles to electronics, space technology, healthcare and emerging industries, the state has distinguished itself through innovation, skill and industrial excellence.

The people of Tamil Nadu take immense pride in their cultural identity and traditions. Tamil culture has enriched our nation’s civilisational journey in innumerable ways.

May this occasion bring happiness, success and new opportunities to every person of Tamil Nadu in the times to come.

தமிழ்நாட்டு மக்கள் அனைவருக்கும் இந்த சிறப்பான தமிழ்நாடு தினத்தில் மனம் நிறைந்த  நல்வாழ்த்துகள்!

தொழில்முனைவோடு கடின உழைப்பும் மிக்கவர்களாய் விளங்கும் தமிழ்நாட்டு மக்கள் இந்தியாவின் வளர்ச்சிக்கு மகத்தான பங்களிப்பை வழங்கியுள்ளனர். உற்பத்தித் துறை முதல் வாகனங்கள் மற்றும் ஜவுளித்துறை, மின்னணுவியல், விண்வெளி தொழில்நுட்பம், மருத்துவம் மற்றும் வளர்ந்துவரும் தொழில்துறைகள் வரை, தமிழகம் தனித்துவமிக்க கண்டுபிடிப்பு, திறன் மற்றும் தொழில்துறை சிறப்புகளை தன்னகத்தே கொண்டு சிறந்து விளங்குகிறது.

தமிழ்நாட்டு மக்கள் தங்கள் பண்பாடு, தனித்துவம் மற்றும் பாரம்பரியம் குறித்து பெருமிதம் கொள்கின்றனர். தமிழ் கலாச்சாரம் நம் நாட்டின் நாகரிகப் பயணத்தைப் பல வழிகளில் செழுமையாக்கியுள்ளது.

இந்த நன்னாள் தமிழ்நாட்டில் உள்ள ஒவ்வொருவருக்கும் இன்றும் வரும் காலங்களிலும் மகிழ்ச்சியையும், வெற்றியையும், புதிய வாய்ப்புகளையும் வாரி வழங்கட்டும்.

 

Warm greetings to the people of Tamil Nadu on the special occasion of Tamil Nadu Day! The hardworking and enterprising people of Tamil Nadu have made outstanding contributions to India’s progress. From manufacturing, automobiles and textiles to electronics, space technology, healthcare and emerging industries, the state has distinguished itself through innovation, skill and industrial excellence. The people of Tamil Nadu take immense pride in their cultural identity and traditions. Tamil culture has enriched our nation’s civilisational journey in innumerable ways. May this occasion bring happiness, success and new opportunities to every person of Tamil Nadu in the times to come. தமிழ்நாட்டு மக்கள் அனைவருக்கும் இந்த சிறப்பான தமிழ்நாடு தினத்தில் மனம் நிறைந்த நல்வாழ்த்துகள்! தொழில்முனைவோடு கடின உழைப்பும் மிக்கவர்களாய் விளங்கும் தமிழ்நாட்டு மக்கள் இந்தியாவின் வளர்ச்சிக்கு மகத்தான பங்களிப்பை வழங்கியுள்ளனர். உற்பத்தித் துறை முதல் வாகனங்கள் மற்றும் ஜவுளித்துறை, மின்னணுவியல், விண்வெளி தொழில்நுட்பம், மருத்துவம் மற்றும் வளர்ந்துவரும் தொழில்துறைகள் வரை, தமிழகம் தனித்துவமிக்க கண்டுபிடிப்பு, திறன் மற்றும் தொழில்துறை சிறப்புகளை தன்னகத்தே கொண்டு சிறந்து விளங்குகிறது. தமிழ்நாட்டு மக்கள் தங்கள் பண்பாடு, தனித்துவம் மற்றும் பாரம்பரியம் குறித்து பெருமிதம் கொள்கின்றனர். தமிழ் கலாச்சாரம் நம் நாட்டின் நாகரிகப் பயணத்தைப் பல வழிகளில் செழுமையாக்கியுள்ளது. இந்த நன்னாள் தமிழ்நாட்டில் உள்ள ஒவ்வொருவருக்கும் இன்றும் வரும் காலங்களிலும் மகிழ்ச்சியையும், வெற்றியையும், புதிய வாய்ப்புகளையும் வாரி வழங்கட்டும்.

item.content:encoded:
Prime Minister's Office
Prime Minister extends greetings to the people of Karnataka on Kannada Rajyotsava
Posted On: 01 NOV 2026 12:42PM by PIB Delhi

The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has extended greetings to the people of Karnataka on the occasion of Kannada Rajyotsava, today. Shri Modi said that Karnataka is a land of rich traditions, remarkable achievements and immense possibilities. Its glorious heritage and timeless customs have enriched our nation’s cultural fabric.

"The people of Karnataka have distinguished themselves through their hard work, enterprise and remarkable skills, especially in futuristic sectors. From information technology, biotechnology and aerospace to artificial intelligence, advanced manufacturing and StartUps, the people of Karnataka have time and again shown their dexterity", Shri Modi remarked.

The Prime Minister posted on X:

Warm greetings to the people of Karnataka on the joyous occasion of Kannada Rajyotsava!

Karnataka is a land of rich traditions, remarkable achievements and immense possibilities. Its glorious heritage and timeless customs have enriched our nation’s cultural fabric.

The people of Karnataka have distinguished themselves through their hard work, enterprise and remarkable skills, especially in futuristic sectors. From information technology, biotechnology and aerospace to artificial intelligence, advanced manufacturing and StartUps, the people of Karnataka have time and again shown their dexterity. They are at the forefront of providing solutions to pressing global challenges. 

May this special occasion bring joy and prosperity in the lives of the people.

ಕನ್ನಡ ರಾಜ್ಯೋತ್ಸವದ ಶುಭ ಸಂದರ್ಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಜನತೆಗೆ ಹೃತ್ಪೂರ್ವಕ ಶುಭಾಶಯಗಳು!

ಕರ್ನಾಟಕವು ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ ಪರಂಪರೆ, ಗಮನಾರ್ಹ ಸಾಧನೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅಪಾರ ಸಾಧ್ಯತೆಗಳ ನಾಡಾಗಿದೆ. ಇದರ ವೈಭವೋಪೇತ ಪಾರಂಪರಿಕ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠತೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಸಾರ್ವಕಾಲಿಕ ಆಚಾರ, ವಿಚಾರಗಳು ನಮ್ಮ ದೇಶದ ಸಾಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಕ ಭವ್ಯತೆಯನ್ನು ಮತ್ತಷ್ಟು ಶ್ರೀಮಂತಗೊಳಿಸಿವೆ.

ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಜನರು ತಮ್ಮ ಕಠಿಣ ಪರಿಶ್ರಮ, ಉದ್ಯಮಶೀಲತೆ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಶೇಷವಾಗಿ ಭವಿಷ್ಯದ ವಲಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿನ ಅದ್ಭುತ ಕೌಶಲ್ಯಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ತಮ್ಮದೇ ಆದ ವಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಛಾಪು ಮೂಡಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಮಾಹಿತಿ ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನ, ಜೈವಿಕ ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಬಾಹ್ಯಾಕಾಶ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಿಂದ ಹಿಡಿದು ಕೃತಕ ಬುದ್ಧಿಮತ್ತೆ, ಸುಧಾರಿತ ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಸ್ಟಾರ್ಟ್‌ಅಪ್‌ಗಳವರೆಗೆ, ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಜನರು ತಮ್ಮ ಚಾಣಾಕ್ಷತೆ ಹಾಗೂ ನೈಪುಣ್ಯತೆಯನ್ನು ಪದೇ ಪದೇ ಪ್ರದರ್ಶಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಅವರು ಜಾಗತಿಕ ಮಟ್ಟದ ಜಟಿಲ ಸವಾಲುಗಳಿಗೆ ಪರಿಹಾರಗಳನ್ನು ಒದಗಿಸುವಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಂಚೂಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿದ್ದಾರೆ.

ಈ ವಿಶೇಷ ಸಂದರ್ಭವು ಜನರ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂತಸ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮೃದ್ಧಿಯನ್ನು ತರಲಿ ಎಂದು ಹಾರೈಸುತ್ತೇನೆ.


Warm greetings to the people of Karnataka on the joyous occasion of Kannada Rajyotsava! Karnataka is a land of rich traditions, remarkable achievements and immense possibilities. Its glorious heritage and timeless customs have enriched our nation’s cultural fabric. The people of Karnataka have distinguished themselves through their hard work, enterprise and remarkable skills, especially in futuristic sectors. From information technology, biotechnology and aerospace to artificial intelligence, advanced manufacturing and StartUps, the people of Karnataka have time and again shown their dexterity. They are at the forefront of providing solutions to pressing global challenges. May this special occasion bring joy and prosperity in the lives of the people. ಕನ್ನಡ ರಾಜ್ಯೋತ್ಸವದ ಶುಭ ಸಂದರ್ಭದಲ್ಲಿ ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಜನತೆಗೆ ಹೃತ್ಪೂರ್ವಕ ಶುಭಾಶಯಗಳು! ಕರ್ನಾಟಕವು ಶ್ರೀಮಂತ ಪರಂಪರೆ, ಗಮನಾರ್ಹ ಸಾಧನೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಅಪಾರ ಸಾಧ್ಯತೆಗಳ ನಾಡಾಗಿದೆ. ಇದರ ವೈಭವೋಪೇತ ಪಾರಂಪರಿಕ ಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠತೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಸಾರ್ವಕಾಲಿಕ ಆಚಾರ, ವಿಚಾರಗಳು ನಮ್ಮ ದೇಶದ ಸಾಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಕ ಭವ್ಯತೆಯನ್ನು ಮತ್ತಷ್ಟು ಶ್ರೀಮಂತಗೊಳಿಸಿವೆ. ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಜನರು ತಮ್ಮ ಕಠಿಣ ಪರಿಶ್ರಮ, ಉದ್ಯಮಶೀಲತೆ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಶೇಷವಾಗಿ ಭವಿಷ್ಯದ ವಲಯಗಳಲ್ಲಿನ ಅದ್ಭುತ ಕೌಶಲ್ಯಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ತಮ್ಮದೇ ಆದ ವಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ಛಾಪು ಮೂಡಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಮಾಹಿತಿ ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನ, ಜೈವಿಕ ತಂತ್ರಜ್ಞಾನ ಮತ್ತು ಬಾಹ್ಯಾಕಾಶ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಿಂದ ಹಿಡಿದು ಕೃತಕ ಬುದ್ಧಿಮತ್ತೆ, ಸುಧಾರಿತ ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆ ಹಾಗೂ ಸ್ಟಾರ್ಟ್‌ಅಪ್‌ಗಳವರೆಗೆ, ಕರ್ನಾಟಕದ ಜನರು ತಮ್ಮ ಚಾಣಾಕ್ಷತೆ ಹಾಗೂ ನೈಪುಣ್ಯತೆಯನ್ನು ಪದೇ ಪದೇ ಪ್ರದರ್ಶಿಸಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಅವರು ಜಾಗತಿಕ ಮಟ್ಟದ ಜಟಿಲ ಸವಾಲುಗಳಿಗೆ ಪರಿಹಾರಗಳನ್ನು ಒದಗಿಸುವಲ್ಲಿ ಮುಂಚೂಣಿಯಲ್ಲಿದ್ದಾರೆ. ಈ ವಿಶೇಷ ಸಂದರ್ಭವು ಜನರ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂತಸ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮೃದ್ಧಿಯನ್ನು ತರಲಿ ಎಂದು ಹಾರೈಸುತ್ತೇನೆ.

— Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) November 1, 2026

 

***
